{{Short description|Norwegian nuclear physicist (1926–2021)}}
'''Arnfinn Graue''' (October 1, 1926 - February 28, 2021) was a Norwegian nuclear physicist.<ref>{{Cite web|title=Vi minnes med respekt en engasjert fagmann|url=https://www.bt.no/minneord/i/Epzj3A/vi-minnes-med-respekt-en-engasjert-fagmann|access-date=2021-03-06|website=www.bt.no|date=5 March 2021 |language=nb}}</ref> 

He was born in [[Bergen]]. He was appointed a [[docent]] at the [[University of Bergen]] from 1961, took the [[dr.philos.]] degree in 1966 and was promoted to professor in experimental nuclear physics in 1971. He served as [[Dean (academic)|dean]] of the Faculty of Natural Sciences from 1978 to 1980, vice rector from 1981 to 1983 and rector from 1984 to 1989. He was also a Norwegian delegate to [[CERN]] from 1984.<ref name=snl>{{cite encyclopedia|year=|title=Arnfinn Graue|encyclopedia=[[Store norske leksikon]]|editor=|publisher=Kunnskapsforlaget|location=Oslo|url=https://www.snl.no/Arnfinn_Graue|language=Norwegian|accessdate=27 February 2011}}</ref>
